import importlib.util,json,pathlib,subprocess
import pytest

ROOT=pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("supervisor",ROOT/"control/codex_supervisor/supervisor.py")
m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(m)

def task():
    prompt="test"
    return dict(task_id="T",task_class="research_review",priority=1,expected_value=1,estimated_reasoning_cost=1,created_at="2026-10-05",prompt=prompt,input_sha256=m.digest(prompt.encode()))

def patch_runtime(tmp_path,monkeypatch,models):
    cache=tmp_path/".codex";cache.mkdir()
    (cache/"models_cache.json").write_text(json.dumps({"models":models}))
    monkeypatch.setattr(m.P,"home",classmethod(lambda cls:tmp_path))
    monkeypatch.setattr(m.subprocess,"run",lambda *a,**k:subprocess.CompletedProcess(a,0,"Logged in using ChatGPT",""))

def test_deceptive_astra_slug_is_rejected(tmp_path,monkeypatch):
    patch_runtime(tmp_path,monkeypatch,[{"slug":"wrapper-gpt-6-astra","display_name":"GPT-6 Astra","visibility":"list","priority":1}])
    t=task();t["model_policy"]="ASTRA_EXACT";t["astra_review_task"]=True
    with pytest.raises(m.Blocked,match="ASTRA_MODEL_UNAVAILABLE_OR_AMBIGUOUS"):
        m.CodexWorker("codex")(t,None,tmp_path,7)

def test_deceptive_gpt_substring_is_not_builder(tmp_path,monkeypatch):
    patch_runtime(tmp_path,monkeypatch,[
        {"slug":"wrapper-gpt-reasoner","display_name":"Other Reasoner","visibility":"list","priority":1},
        {"slug":"gpt-5-6-sol","display_name":"GPT-5.6 Sol","visibility":"list","priority":7},
    ])
    seen={}
    class Process:
        pid=123;returncode=0
        def communicate(self,*a,**k):return None
    def popen(args,**kw):
        seen["args"]=args;return Process()
    monkeypatch.setattr(m.subprocess,"Popen",popen)
    assert m.CodexWorker("codex")(task(),None,tmp_path,7)==0
    assert seen["args"][seen["args"].index("-m")+1]=="gpt-5-6-sol"

from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json
root=Path.cwd()
cfg=json.loads((root/"knowledge/codex_runtime/CONFIG.json").read_text())
mapping={
"candidate_dispatch.py_sha256":"control/codex_supervisor/candidate_dispatch.py",
"candidate_policy_sha256":"control/hourly/candidate_queue.py",
"evidence_wake.py_sha256":"control/codex_supervisor/evidence_wake.py",
"build_wake.py_sha256":"control/codex_supervisor/build_wake.py",
"model_quality_gate.py_sha256":"control/codex_supervisor/model_quality_gate.py",
"astra_review_wake.py_sha256":"control/codex_supervisor/astra_review_wake.py",
"measurement_wake.py_sha256":"control/codex_supervisor/measurement_wake.py",
"supervisor_sha256":"control/codex_supervisor/supervisor.py",
"astra_autonomous_review.py_sha256":"control/codex_supervisor/astra_autonomous_review.py"}
bad=[]
for k,r in mapping.items():
 a=hashlib.sha256((root/r).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
 if cfg.get(k)!=a:bad.append(k)
print("PIN_VERIFY="+json.dumps({"checked":len(mapping),"mismatch":bad},sort_keys=True),flush=True)
if bad: raise SystemExit(41)
